Build modules from circles, rounded rectangles, semicircles, wedges and clean arcs; each module only 2-4 large shapes, clear bold silhouette. Uniform clean dark outline, narrow clean white cutout edge, completely flat 2-tone fills, no paper grain. Positive stat shape subtly informs silhouette: triangle fin for speed, square jaw/claw for strength, hexagon plate for survival. Parts overlap organically rather than float apart. The result feels like a playful icon system grew into a collectible creature, preserving the rigor of the app.
